item.title: Apple to increase spend with Broadcom to produce billions more U.S. chips
item.description:

item.title: US Food and Drug Administration rejects petition to set PFAS limits in food
item.description:
📝 Testing has found the levels of Pfas in single servings of some contaminated foods to be equivalent to drinking many glasses of contaminated water. Pfas gets into food because it is commonly used in pesticides, food packaging and sewage sludge used as fertilizer. Some independent testing has found high levels of Pfas in blueberries, kale and other water-rich produce because the chemicals are attracted to water.
🔗 Read more: https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/jul/08/us-food-and-drug-administration-rejects-petition-to-set-pfas-limits-in-food
